entities.summary: Gerald Thomas Flynn was an American lawyer and Democratic politician from Racine, Wisconsin. He served one term in the United States House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 1st congressional district during the 86th United States Congress (1959–1961). He previously served four years in the Wisconsin Senate, representing Racine County.
